_comment: Runtime configuration for video production. The n8n Config node passes the `runtime` block into the media sub-workflow, exactly as factory.config.json does for the course pipeline. Nothing here is a secret.

captions._comment: Applied LAST, after every overlay, per video-use rule 1. The caption zone in brand/spacing.json is reserved so no overlay can be placed there.

editing._comment: Educational speech is not over-edited: pauses that carry meaning are kept, and a cut never lands inside a word.

storyboard._comment: rules = deterministic only (free); rules+llm = one structured refinement call (default); agent = full Claude Code pass, requested per course.

face._comment: HeyGen is the long-term primary; a user-supplied recording is the fallback and is what the current test uses. Both normalise to PresenterVideoSource.

heygen._comment: enabled flips to true when HEYGEN_API_KEY exists in the worker environment.

narration._comment: When the approved course version already has narration on the course worker, reuse it: it costs nothing and it is the audio a human approved. Only synthesise when it is missing or the script changed.

cache._comment: Cache keys are content hashes. A single changed scene recomposites that scene only; unchanged scenes are reused.

qa._comment: transcript_match_threshold compares the rendered narration against the APPROVED script. Below it, the render is held for manual review rather than shown to a reviewer.
